authorization_scope: Independent offline review and verification. This approval does not authorize publication, credentials, paid API calls, workflow activation or a live benchmark.

resolved_findings.finding: Invalid instruction and criterion description root types could pass input validation; media checks omitted question content.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit root-type checks and media scanning now cover state, instructions and criteria; regression test passes.

resolved_findings.finding: An empty Clef baseline marked complete could evade the exact-ID check.
resolved_findings.resolution: Every complete baseline must now match the exact frozen request ID set, including when empty; regression test passes.

resolved_findings.finding: Retry-After accepted only numeric delay values.
resolved_findings.resolution: HTTP-date parsing added with bounded-wait handling; regression test passes.

resolved_findings.finding: Prose called 65536 the documented exact token capacity.
resolved_findings.resolution: Now accurately identified as a conservative reservation interpretation of the documented 64k limit.

security_and_protocol_observations: Fixed first-party endpoint, default TLS validation, redirects refused and proxy discovery disabled.
At most 974 initial calls plus 50 retries; reservations persist before sending; ambiguous transport outcomes are not retried.
Credential remains scoped to the live workflow step. Raw requests, response bodies, headers and exception text are not logged or uploaded.
Frozen inference inputs exclude scorer gold metadata, retain native question shapes, and change only the model identifier.
Native probability vectors are used for common scoring; vendor confidence is retained separately.
Input-body hashes bind valid Jev observations to the frozen requests.
MASSIVE Clef baseline remains pending rather than fabricated or partially imported.
Manual workflow template remains inactive and requires a separately reviewed immutable code commit and explicit bounded approval.
Seven attack-removal pairs and 30 original/20 finance language-control groups are explicitly retained; paired labels and option sets are compatible.
caveats: All extra transport responses were synthetic and temporary. They are software tests, not Jev observations or benchmark results.
No live TypeSafe behavior, account balance, billing terms, ordinary retention duration or credentials were verified.
The USD 3 local reservation guard is not a provider-enforced account spending guarantee.
Frozen dependent synthetic cases support descriptive paired comparisons, not independent-sample or pooled ranking claims.
CPU-NF4 Clef and hosted Jev latency/hardware measurements have different boundaries.
Final MASSIVE head-to-head scoring requires its separately audited, pinned Clef baseline.
publication_scope_note: The following records the original preparation review. A later curated-export review verifies current public metadata and immutable scientific content.
